messages:
Sophie: Heads up — working on saved filters UX for console analytics. Need a quick decision: when someone saves a view scoped to a route that currently has a pinned model, do we show the routing/model pins as locked in the saved-view preview or merely suggested? Need to decide before Friday rollout.

Jamal: I'd vote for locking by default for `route+model` saves. Too many surprises when the model changes under you. For the API shape I was thinking `scope = \"route\"` plus an explicit `pinned_models` array.

Maria Chen: +1 on lock. Also we should surface telemetry in the preview: sample rate, last-24h token burn, and an estimated token delta if the pinned model is different. That helps product teams judge cost before restore. :+1:

Oliver: UI note — console real estate is tight. We can't dump all telemetry inline. Propose a compact row: [ModelChip] [cost delta badge] [i]. Hover or flyout for details with sample rate and last-applied pin provenance.

Kevin (PM): Rollout concern: locking pins changes semantics for a bunch of existing savedviews that effectively acted as route-only. Need migration plan (opt-in banner or auto migrate with confirmation). Put behind feature flag `console.savedview.v2`.

Sophie: Agreed on migration. Jamal — can we keep API backward-compatible and add fields to opt into pin-locking?

Jamal: Sketch of the contract (quick draft):

```json
{
  \"name\": \"string\",
  \"scope\": \"route|model|global\",
  \"route_id\": \"string\",
  \"pinned_models\": [\"string\"],
  \"preview\": {
    \"sample_rate\": \"number\",
    \"token_estimate\": \"number\",
    \"locked\": true
  }
}
```

Maria Chen: Add a lightweight `provenance` field to the preview so users can see who/what last mutated the pins (user id, timestamp, reason). Very helpful for audits and support.

Oliver: UI idea: tiny provenance hover on the model chip: \"pinned by Maria Chen • 2025-02-14 • autosuggested by Optimize\". That solves the support noise.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rolling out `savedview-v2` feature flag to staging at 2024-09-12T18:22Z :rocket:

Sophie: Great — I'll draft an RFC summarizing: default-lock for route+model saves, new preview fields (`sample_rate`, `token_estimate`, `provenance`), feature flag, and migration UX (banner + consent). Action items: Jamal implement API stub, Oliver wire compact ModelChip + flyout, Maria add telemetry endpoints, Kevin coordinate rollout messaging. Tagging #product for sanity check. :eyes:

Jamal: I'll post a follow-up with the exact API schema and a minimal migration script example.

Maria Chen: Thanks — I'll add the telemetry panel mockups to the RFC.

Oliver: I'll prototype the chip this afternoon, will DM Sophie when ready.
